lane:
فِنْدِيرٌ (S, K) and فِنْدِيرَةٌ (S, M, K) _A great mass of rock that projects,_ or _juts out,_ (تَنْدُرُ,) _from the head of a mountain:_ (S:) what is thus called is _short of_ (دُونَ) _what is termed_ فِدْرَة [in relation to a mountain]; (M, K;) by which may be meat دون _in respect of place and projection, not in respect of size._ (TA.) [See also فِدْرَةٌ and فَادِرَةٌ: and see more in art. فندر.]

فِنْدِيرٌ and ↓فِنْدِيرَةٌ (K in this art., and S in art. فدر,) _A great mass of rock that becomes detached_ (S, K) _from the head_ (S) or _from the side_ (K) _of a mountain:_ (S, K:) pl. فَنَادِيرُ. (TA.) === And, both words, _A large lump_ of dates (K, TA) _compacted together;_ as also فِدْرَةٌ. (TA.)

entries.text: الفندير، بالكسر وبالهاء: قطعة ضخمة من تمر، والصخرة العظيمة تنقلع عن عرض الجبل.
